source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1054 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1054 was established by Ordinance No. 31904, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 9, 2021. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1054 is established on property located in area generally bound by East Grand Avenue, Winslow Avenue, and Beacon Street. The size of PD 1054 is approximately 0.8683 acre. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article, PARK OFFICE AND VEHICLE STORAGE AREA means a City of Dallas facility for various activities and services including but not limited to staff gathering and maintenance vehicle parking by the Department of Park and Recreation.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is divided into two tracts (Tracts I and II) as described in the property description (Exhibit 1054A) and shown on the development plan (Exhibit 1054B).

(d) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 1054A: property description.

(2) Exhibit 1054B: development plan.

(3) Exhibit 1054C: landscape plan. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in R-7.5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) Tract I. A police or fire station limited to a fire station is permitted by right.

(c) Tract II. A park office and vehicle storage area is permitted by right. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District apply.

(b) Police or fire station limited to a fire station.

(1) Setbacks. Setbacks must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(2) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 10,000 square feet.

(3) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 50 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(c) Park office and vehicle storage area. Setbacks must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) Police or fire station limited to a fire station and park office and vehicle storage area.

(1) Off-street parking and loading must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(2) For purposes of off-street parking and loading, this district is considered to be one lot. Parking on Tracts I and II may be used to accommodate daily shift change overlap of vehicles between the police or fire station limited to a fire station and the park office and vehicle storage area. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 1054C). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.113. SCREENING.

(a) Masonry screening must be provided in the locations shown on the development plan.

(b) Trash and recycling containers located on Tract I and shared with the uses on Tract II must be screened from public rights-of-way by a fence and gates.

(c) Screening of above-ground fuel storage tanks must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(d) Screening of off-street parking must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Sidewalks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.114. SIDEWALKS.

(a) Sidewalks and buffers must be provided in accordance with Chapter 51A, except where the city arborist determines existing trees and screening walls interfere with the installation of new sidewalks and buffers, the sidewalks existing as of June 9, 2021 may remain.

(b) Sidewalks across fire apparatus drives must be designated by a contrasting surface. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.115. LIGHTING.

(a) Exterior lighting must be directed away from adjacent properties.

(b) Light fixtures must be attached to buildings or mounted on metal poles at a height not to exceed 35 feet above grade.

(c) All pole-mounted light fixtures must be full cut-off fixtures. For purposes of this subsection, FULL CUT-OFF FIXURE means a light fixture that does not emit light above the fixture’s horizontal angle. Full cut-off fixtures direct light down to the ground. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.116. INGRESS AND EGRESS.

(a) Ingress and egress must be provided at the locations shown on the development plan for the two apparatus driveways.

(b) The staff entrance driveway for the police or fire station limited to a fire station on Tract I may be shared with the park office and vehicle storage area on Tract II upon execution of a mutual access agreement.

(c) No other ingress or egress is permitted. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.117. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31904)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1054.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31904)
